Symbolism

One Sun at the Centre

Every curve in the emblem is a circle drawn around the sun: learning is the centre that everything else grows out from.

The Sun & Palay Rays

The light of learning, its rays drawn as grains of palay: the harvest and the gold of Rosario.

The Bridge as an Orbit

The hanging bridge’s main cable is the lower arc of the sun’s halo, and an open book is its deck: education connects learners to opportunity and to one another.

The Mountains

Twin sunlit peaks with their shoulders stand for the upland community the school serves.

The Golden Terraces

Rice terraces climb the hills in rings that ripple out from the sun: the land, its fields, and its mines, on which the school stands.

The Woven Border

A Cordillera-inspired diamond weave frames the whole emblem, holding the school’s Indigenous learners and heritage around everything it does.

Typography
Instrument Serif

INSTRUMENT SANS

Scale and Legibility
  • Minimum size: 24 px / 8 mm wide for the emblem.
  • Below 36 px, use the emblem alone — no wordmark.
  • Clear space on all sides: the width of the sun.
